source.publication: Rhode Island Retirement Income Tax Guide, Publication 2026-01 (tax year 2025)
source.section: Instructions PDF pp.9-10, Schedule M line 1t, questions 1 and 2 and table lines 1-4; Guide PDF p.12, note under the full retirement age table: 'applies only to that spouse's taxable pension and annuity income'; Instructions PDF p.4, RI-1040 lines 1-5; PDF p.5, lines 6-8; PDF p.13, Tax Computation Worksheet ('Use for all filing status types')

worked: Federal AGI = wages 20,000.00 + private pension (person 0) 40,000.00 + private pension (person 1) 30,000.00 = 90,000.00. Federal taxable income = 90,000.00 - 31,500.00 standard deduction - 1 x 1,600.00 age 65+ = 56,900.00 (given, not tested; federal senior deduction ignored). RI-1040 line 1 federal AGI 90,000.00. Line 1t: question 1 born on or before March 1, 1959: person 0 born 1955-06-15 (age 70), person 1 born 1961-06-15 (age 64): yes; question 2 federal AGI 90,000.00 less than or equal to 133,750.00: yes. Table: person 0 line 2 40,000.00, line 3 lesser of that and 50,000.00 = 40,000.00; person 1 line 2 0.00, line 3 lesser of that and 50,000.00 = 0.00; line 4 = 40,000.00. Line 1y total decreasing modifications = 40,000.00. Line 2a other-state obligations 0.00; line 2m total increasing modifications = 0.00. Schedule M page 2 line 3 net = 0.00 - 40,000.00 = -40,000.00; RI-1040 line 2 = -40,000.00. Line 3 modified federal AGI = 90,000.00 + (-40,000.00) = 50,000.00. Standard Deduction and Exemption Worksheets: line 3 50,000.00 is not more than 254,250.00: the worksheets stop at line 3, full amounts. Line 4 standard deduction: 21,800.00 (Married filing jointly). Line 5 = 50,000.00 - 21,800.00 = 28,200.00. Line 6 exemptions: 2 x 5,100.00 = 10,200.00. Line 7 taxable income = 28,200.00 - 10,200.00 = 18,000.00. Line 8 tax on 18,000.00 by the schedule as numbers: 18,000.00 x 0.0375 = 675.000000 = 675.00. Credits 0.00 (Schedule I, Schedule II, RI earned income credit and RI-1040H are not modelled and not claimed here). Rhode Island income tax = 675.00. Note: Only the older spouse's pension counts; table line 2 for the 64-year-old is blank.
